author: Miss_Ice
quote: I love Zelda. I’ve been a fan of the franchise for years, and when they announced the *Ocarina* remake, I burst into tears of joy. But immediately after, I started to worry: what if they ruined the game that made video game history? What if it didn’t move me the way it did all those years ago? Still, with my heart in my throat, I decided to buy it—and you know what? It didn’t disappoint. It felt like coming home: the enhanced graphics, the new mechanics, the music—Epona, Zelda, and even Ganondorf himself—are all incredible. Link looks fantastic; you have to get used to the new design, but the work put into the characters is truly wonderful. If I had to point out a minor flaw, I’d admit that Epona’s movements feel a bit stiff, and the decision to keep the game identical to the original means some dungeons have become a bit easier. But honestly? These things didn’t affect my overall verdict. This game is a must-play. And I don’t just say that as a fan of the series, but as someone who loves video games above all else. Thank you, Nintendo—in a gaming world that has become quite rotten, you’ve given us something so pure and beautiful.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Miss_Ice
quote: To be honest, I’m not a fan of the GTA series—none of the entries, really—but I decided to give this one a chance. Given all the hype surrounding it, I expected much more. It struggles to maintain 30 fps (I’m playing on a PS5), the plot didn’t excite me at all, and—even though I’m not a fan—it feels like this game has strayed from the core essence of the franchise. "Political correctness" has had a heavy influence on the IP. The fact that there’s no physical copy really caught me off guard; I would have expected one to be included, at least in the collector’s edition—or perhaps as an optional add-on (though 80–100 euros already feels like a very steep price). I did appreciate the map included in the case; these are the kinds of nice touches that, in my opinion, people were hoping to see in this new release. Furthermore, some of the "innovative" mechanics turned out to be less impressive or effective than expected. The bugs I encountered are truly embarrassing and completely unacceptable. The graphics are undeniably beautiful, but spending around 100 euros only to end up with this leaves a bitter taste in my mouth. I feel genuinely sorry for those who have been waiting for this for so many years. It also bothers me that gaming outlets praised a product that, when all is said and done, is largely just a product of the hype.
